  49569: 	private void ApplyGPUSelection(int selectedIndex)
  49570: 	{
  49571: 		int gPUDetectionLevel = Display.GPUDetectionLevel;
  49572: 		int num = selectedIndex switch
  49573: 		{
  49574: 			1 => 0, 
  49575: 			2 => 1, 
  49576: 			3 => 2, 
  49577: 			_ => gPUDetectionLevel, 
  49578: 		};

  49580: 		Display.GPUEffectsEnabled = num >= 1 && GPUDetector.HasBuiltInEffects;
  49581: 		Display.AutoEnableGPU = num >= 1;
  49582: 		if (hasDeviceContext || selectedIndex != 0)
  49583: 		{
  49584: 			UpdateWaterfallRenderQualityItems(num);
  49585: 		}
  49586: 		else
  49587: 		{
  49588: 			_renderFilterPending = true;
  49589: 		}
  49590: 		UpdateWaterfallPaletteItems(num >= 1);
  49591: 		SyncGPUWaterfallPipelineEnabled(num);
  49592: 		if (hasDeviceContext)
  49593: 		{
  49594: 			if (num >= 2 && !GPUDetector.HasCustomShaders)
  49595: 			{
  49596: 				MessageBox.Show("Custom HLSL shaders (Level 2) are not available in this build.\nUsing Level 1 (Built-in Effects) instead.", "GPU Acceleration", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button1, (MessageBoxOptions)262144);

  49569: 	private void ApplyGPUSelection(int selectedIndex)
  49570: 	{
  49571: 		int gPUDetectionLevel = Display.GPUDetectionLevel;
  49572: 		int num = selectedIndex switch
  49573: 		{
  49574: 			1 => 0, 
  49575: 			2 => 1, 
  49576: 			3 => 2, 
  49577: 			_ => gPUDetectionLevel, 
  49578: 		};
  49579: 		bool hasDeviceContext = GPUDetector.HasDeviceContext;
  49580: 		Display.GPUEffectsEnabled = num >= 1 && GPUDetector.HasBuiltInEffects;
  49581: 		Display.AutoEnableGPU = num >= 1;
  49582: 		if (hasDeviceContext || selectedIndex != 0)
  49583: 		{
  49584: 			UpdateWaterfallRenderQualityItems(num);
  49585: 		}
  49586: 		else
  49587: 		{
  49588: 			_renderFilterPending = true;
  49589: 		}
  49590: 		UpdateWaterfallPaletteItems(num >= 1);
  49591: 		SyncGPUWaterfallPipelineEnabled(num);
  49592: 		if (hasDeviceContext)
  49593: 		{
  49594: 			if (num >= 2 && !GPUDetector.HasCustomShaders)
  49595: 			{
  49596: 				MessageBox.Show("Custom HLSL shaders (Level 2) are not available in this build.\nUsing Level 1 (Built-in Effects) instead.", "GPU Acceleration", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button1, (MessageBoxOptions)262144);
  49597: 			}

  49569: 	private void ApplyGPUSelection(int selectedIndex)
  49570: 	{
  49571: 		int gPUDetectionLevel = Display.GPUDetectionLevel;
  49572: 		int num = selectedIndex switch
  49573: 		{
  49574: 			1 => 0, 
  49575: 			2 => 1, 
  49576: 			3 => 2, 
  49577: 			_ => gPUDetectionLevel, 
  49578: 		};
  49579: 		bool hasDeviceContext = GPUDetector.HasDeviceContext;
  49580: 		Display.GPUEffectsEnabled = num >= 1 && GPUDetector.HasBuiltInEffects;
  49581: 		Display.AutoEnableGPU = num >= 1;
  49582: 		if (hasDeviceContext || selectedIndex != 0)
  49583: 		{
  49584: 			UpdateWaterfallRenderQualityItems(num);
  49585: 		}
  49586: 		else
  49587: 		{
  49588: 			_renderFilterPending = true;
  49589: 		}
  49590: 		UpdateWaterfallPaletteItems(num >= 1);
  49591: 		SyncGPUWaterfallPipelineEnabled(num);
  49592: 		if (hasDeviceContext)
  49593: 		{
  49594: 			if (num >= 2 && !GPUDetector.HasCustomShaders)
  49595: 			{
  49596: 				MessageBox.Show("Custom HLSL shaders (Level 2) are not available in this build.\nUsing Level 1 (Built-in Effects) instead.", "GPU Acceleration", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button1, (MessageBoxOptions)262144);
  49597: 			}
  49598: 			else if (num >= 1 && !GPUDetector.HasBuiltInEffects)
  49599: 			{
  49600: 				MessageBox.Show("Built-in D2D Effects are not available on this system.\nUsing CPU post-processing (Level 0).", "GPU Acceleration", MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk, MessageBoxDefaultButton.Button1, (MessageBoxOptions)262144);
  49601: 			}
  49602: 		}
  49603: 	}

  50804: 	private void radTCI_spot_force_CheckedChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)

  50814: 		else

  50817: 		}

  50819: 		{
  50820: 			console.TCIServer.CWSpotForce = _tci_spot_force;
  50821: 		}
  50822: 	}
